indexEntry.body:
Current or former University of Waterloo students are required to submit an Application for Undergraduate Readmission if:

  • they have received a Failed - Required to Withdraw academic standing decision;
  • they have a voluntary absence from studies;
  • they are seeking to upgrade their undergraduate degree;
  • they are seeking another undergraduate degree (e.g., a second degree in a different discipline); or
  • they are seeking to take courses as a post-degree/non-degree student.
indexEntry.title: Readmission
